workflow.disagreement_policy: one isolated pivotal-proposition check followed by endpoint-only selection

primary_evaluation.unit: victim model aggregated equally over all three attackers on the same 61 claim clusters
primary_evaluation.per_victim_attacked_gate: Stage C correct count is strictly greater than both RAG and same-model closed-book over all 183 attacker-claim rows
primary_evaluation.clean_gate: Stage C accuracy on 100 clean claims is no more than 2 percentage points below the stronger clean endpoint
primary_evaluation.overall_gate: at least two of three victim models pass both attacked and clean gates
primary_evaluation.uncertainty: 10,000-sample percentile bootstrap over the 61 claim clusters
required_secondary_reporting: paired gains and regressions against each endpoint

interpretation_limit: The complete development set has informed prior diagnostics; this is an attack-generalization diagnostic, not new confirmatory evidence. No locked claim is opened.

pre_inference_adapter_repair.event: The first runner launch stopped during packet preparation before any LLM request because crossed source tasks use victim_model_id while the unchanged runner consumes standard model_id.
pre_inference_adapter_repair.resolution: Create a derived content-addressed endpoint with model_id, retain victim_model_id and attacker metadata privately, and record the immutable source_cross_task_key. Restart all packet and inference namespaces at v2.

post_inference_parser_repair.event: One of 849 router rows exhausted three contract attempts because GLM misspelled the decisive_conflict JSON key while returning all semantic fields.
post_inference_parser_repair.resolution: Version the router contract as v1.1 and deterministically repair exactly one missing/extra field pair only when their Levenshtein distance is at most two. Rebuild all outputs from immutable cached responses.

completion_record.network_replay: One Qwen proposition-check request timed out. The unchanged idempotent rerun reused 356 completed checks/selectors and made only the missing request plus its dependent selector.
